notes.subject: wantaim
notes.rationale: Hebrew lacks 'with'; the going-out-together is implied by the prince being בתוכם (in their midst).

notes.subject: בבואם יבוא / בצאתם יצאו
notes.rationale: Infinitive-construct paired with finite verb of same root, a repetitive echo that Tok Pisin keeps only partly with 'kam insait/go ausait' twice.

translation: Na nasi i stap namel long ol; taim ol i kam insait, em i kam insait wantaim, na taim ol i go ausait, em i go ausait wantaim.

tokens.gloss: na taim ol i go ausait
